Dear User,

To ensure the security and privacy of account holders, we require verification of your identity before we can proceed with any personal data erasure under the DPDP regulations.

Please provide one of the following verification details by replying directly from your registered email:
1. The last 4 digits of your registered mobile number and a verification selfie, or
2. A masked copy of a Government-issued Photo ID (e.g., Voter ID or Driving Licence).

Please note that our agents cannot accept ID documents sent via third-party automated tools; you must respond to this ticket directly.

Reference: ID-VERIFY-REQ-5510
Security & Compliance Team
